code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}application-downpayments`;const getApplicationDownPaymentsApi=async(params,url="assessments")=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,{params});return response.data;};const getApplicationDownPaymentByUuid=async uuid=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(`${API_URL}/${uuid}`);return response.data;};const createApplicationDownPaymentApi=async body=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,body);return response.data;};const updateApplicationDownPaymentByUuid=async(uuid,body)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(`${API_URL}/${uuid}`,body);return response.data;};const deleteApplicationDownPayment=async uuid=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(`${API_URL}/${uuid}`);return response.data;};const applicationDownPaymentService={getApplicationDownPaymentsApi,getApplicationDownPaymentByUuid,createApplicationDownPaymentApi,updateApplicationDownPaymentByUuid,deleteApplicationDownPayment};export default applicationDownPaymentService;
